blocks.title: Stoichiometry
blocks.text: Stoichiometry is a branch of chemistry which tells us the quantitative relationship between reactants and products in a balanced chemical equation.

With the knowledge of mole, Avogadro’s number, molar mass, molar volume, and molar concentration, we can establish quantitative relationships between reactants and products using the balanced chemical equations.
